seo.title: Metallic Ore Limited | Gold, Diamond & Minerals Exporter, Sierra Leone
seo.description: Metallic Ore Limited is a trusted miner, dealer and exporter of gold, diamonds and other valuable minerals in Sierra Leone and beyond.

hero.lead: A trusted and reliable company specialising in the supply and export of **Gold**, **Diamonds** and other valuable minerals in **Sierra Leone** and beyond.

paragraphs: **Metallic Ore Limited** is a licensed miner, dealer and exporter of gold and diamonds based at Wilkinson Road, Freetown. We connect Sierra Leone's natural resources with buyers around the world through transparent, professional and responsible trade.
From alluvial and rock gold to rough diamonds and industrial minerals, we handle sourcing, assaying, documentation and secure export so our partners can buy with confidence.

items.title: Gold
items.text: High-purity gold dust, nuggets and bars, assayed and traded at fair, market-linked prices.

items.title: Diamonds
items.text: Kimberley Process certified rough diamonds sorted by size, colour and clarity.

items.title: Other Minerals
items.text: Rutile, zircon, ilmenite, bauxite, iron ore and other minerals supplied to specification.

items.title: Export Services
items.text: Licensing, documentation, insured shipping and logistics from Freetown to the world.

prices.title: Live Mineral & Metal Prices
prices.note: Diamond, rutile and industrial mineral prices are negotiated per parcel and depend on grade, size, quantity and terms. Contact Metallic Ore Limited for a firm quote.
